caseNature.title: Case Nature
caseNature.description: The nature of the escalation case. Typically set to 'Complaint' when logging post-delivery issues like damaged goods or shortages.

caseType.title: Case Type
caseType.description: The classification type of the case being created or searched. Typically set to 'Complaint'.

customerEmail.title: Customer Email
customerEmail.description: The email address supplied by the customer for receiving escalation case updates and communication.

customerMobile.title: Customer Mobile
customerMobile.description: The mobile phone number supplied by the customer for contact and SMS updates regarding the escalation case.

subtype.title: Subtype
subtype.description: The specific customer complaint or issue category regarding the delivered shipment (e.g., Material Damaged, Short Delivery, Delay, Delivery Staff Behaviour).

waybillNumber.title: Waybill Number
waybillNumber.description: The 12-digit Safexpress waybill or consignment tracking number provided by the customer for checking status or logging an escalation.
